body: The old stone walls around the well start to shake subtly, their edges casting long shadows across my face as the sun dips below the horizon. I hear whispers among the trees—vivid tales whispered through the night, each one filled with hope for the future. My heart swells with gratitude and determination, knowing this well holds not just water but a beacon of strength.
